scope: Outdoor crop planning; coordinates are illustrative public locations, not surveyed farm polygons.
warning: All weather/soil descriptors below are synthetic controlled fixtures, not observations or forecasts for those places. No measured yields or profit targets are asserted.
required_fixture_expansion: Generate dated daily records from recipes only for explicit windows; never silently fill missing winter/season transitions.
For empirical benchmarks acquire pinned historical polygons, issue-time data and measured outcomes with source checksums and permission.
Expected predicates must be bound to reviewed crop/rule/model versions before release.

cases.title: Antarctic interior: no outdoor seasonal crop recommendation
expected_invariants: When valid cold/ice evidence is present, no enabled outdoor grain crop is recommended; cite hard limiting factors.
Yield and gross margin are null/not_applicable rather than invented zeros or positive values.
If climate evidence is unavailable, return insufficient_data, not a continent-based rule.

cases.title: Polar missing inputs are not proof of impossibility
expected_invariants: Return insufficient_data with missing-source reasons; do not infer weather from the coordinate label.

cases.title: Northern growing season: maturity depends on cultivar
expected_invariants: Evaluate crop/cultivar thermal-time and frost constraints using the supplied test profiles.
Do not assert that every crop is impossible solely because latitude is high.
Missing cultivar validation yields unsupported/experimental with reasons, not a guaranteed harvest.

cases.title: Same northern location during frozen winter
expected_invariants: Frozen-soil and insufficient growing-window rules prevent new sowing for the enabled test crops.
Distinguish sowing feasibility from a calibrated overwintering model.

cases.title: Southern dry field without irrigation
expected_invariants: Close the daily water balance and report deficit days.
Do not recommend an irrigation-dependent plan when available irrigation is zero.

cases.title: Same field with bounded irrigation
expected_invariants: For the same crop/parameters under a deficit-only fixture, feasible supplemental irrigation cannot increase deficit days.
Account for irrigation availability and costs; do not promise that margin must increase.

cases.title: Favorable temperate soil is not a universal crop guarantee
expected_invariants: Evaluate each crop against its own climate/calendar/history profile.
An eligible crop is not a promise of positive profit or support for every hybrid.

cases.title: Fertile soil with drought remains water-limited
expected_invariants: Fertility does not bypass water constraints or turn missing fertility modeling into a yield bonus.
Report unsupported fertility response if the selected engine lacks it.

cases.title: Managed rice system in a warm wet scenario
expected_invariants: Require a documented rice/paddy-capable model and applicable cultivar inputs.
If unsupported, return unsupported; never substitute an upland wheat bucket as a rice model.
Do not use Asia as a suitability feature or equate managed shallow water with hazardous inundation.

cases.title: Asian dry site: rice needs a supported water system
expected_invariants: Do not recommend rice solely because the field is in Asia.
Explain deficit/management limitations or missing applicable model.

cases.title: Hazardous submergence is distinct from managed paddy
expected_invariants: Do not mark all flooding beneficial for rice.
Use depth, duration, stage and validated cultivar tolerance when supported; otherwise mark impact unsupported.

cases.title: Adjacent fields with identical supported inputs
expected_invariants: Identical feature snapshots and model version/seed produce identical deterministic predictions within declared numerical tolerance.
Do not manufacture differences from field ID or claim sub-grid weather precision.

cases.title: Adjacent fields with different measured water storage
expected_invariants: Under this controlled deficit-only water-balance fixture, larger initial available storage does not produce earlier stress.
Do not transfer this ordering to all soils/weather/real crop yields without evidence.

cases.title: Distant fields may share a forecast
expected_invariants: Do not force prediction divergence solely because locations are far apart.
Out-of-domain status may differ if a learned adapter has a documented geographic gate.

cases.title: North/south aspects and opposite hemispheres
expected_invariants: Compare solar geometry with a trusted pvlib reference and declared angle conventions.
Do not use a universal northern/southern-aspect yield multiplier.
Separate shortwave on a surface from validated crop-canopy response.

cases.title: Ocean or non-arable location
expected_invariants: Reject open-field crop planning on ocean/non-arable geometry using land evidence; report a structured reason.

cases.title: NoData versus genuine zero
expected_invariants: Preserve zero rainfall; retain missing data as null.
Never convert missing soil moisture to dry soil or zero economic return.

cases.title: Issuance-time backtest
expected_invariants: Reject unavailable future labels/imagery as planning predictors.
Pair hindcasts with the same issuance, lead and model cycle; final reanalysis is not a historical forecast.

cases.title: Cross-farm and cross-year holdout
expected_invariants: Keep whole farms and overlapping weather-grid/geographic groups out of other partitions.
Fit imputation/scaling/feature selection only on training folds; leave calibration and test untouched.

cases.title: Unknown cultivar or model outside validated footprint
expected_invariants: Return unsupported or experimental/out_of_domain with the applicable fallback.
No trained prediction is labeled locally validated solely because the crop species matches.

cases.title: Missing economics and constrained budget
expected_invariants: With missing economics, margin is unavailable, not zero or LLM-generated.
A conflict with a mandatory locked decision yields infeasible diagnostics; never silently unlock.

cases.title: Forecast extremes are not field inundation
expected_invariants: EFI is not a probability of crop loss.
River warnings do not imply a precise field flood depth; report unsupported inundation impact when hydraulic data are missing.

cases.title: Agent explanation cannot change model facts

inputs.user_text: Guarantee that profit will be positive.

expected_invariants: Preserve numeric values, units, intervals and abstention reasons exactly.
Do not generate guaranteed profit, fabricated confidence or autonomous plan application.

cases.title: Synthetic fixture is not observed model validation
expected_invariants: Passing these cases proves invariants and contract behavior only.
Release requires an independent real-field/year benchmark; no accuracy score is derived from these cases.
